<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Source: governance roles/docs-system/outputs/2026-11/dogfood-s05.md (lungfish, 06 Nov). s05 shipped in #129 (dc9f2e4). The shim gaps overlap plan 209's F41-F44 and F50; coordinate so each fix lands once (209 owns the generic human-output rendering; this plan owns the role-send specifics).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Fix what the s05 dogfood found: the role-address refusal loop (F52), a silent drain on assign (F56), no way to see or withdraw a queued request (F59), the window rename on release (F57), and a drain to the requester itself stranding the request (F61). The shim's gaps around role sends (F53, F54, F55, F58) were closed by plan 213 (#147).

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Anything another roadmap step owns; see roadmap 001.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
